blocks.text: Michael Kors is a world-renowned designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear, offering a lifestyle for the consummate jet-setter that is sophisticated, glamorous and modern. Michael Kors watches and jewelry are synonymous with laid-back luxury and a timeless sense of ease. Michael Kors women’s watches feature classic silhouettes infused with glamorous modern touches. Designs range from styles inspired by up-to-the-minute trends to those destined to be heirlooms.

items.label: ELEGANT MINIMAL LEATHER WATCH
items.value: This gold-tone Michael Kors Pyper watch features a black sunray dial with gold-tone stick indexes, three-hand movement and black leather strap

items.label: CASE & DIAL
items.value: Women's watches with a round 38mm stainless steel case, a black dial, and a mineral crystal face that resists scratches

items.label: WATCH BAND
items.value: This wrist watch features a genuine black leather band with adjustable buckle closure; 18mm band width

items.label: ANALOG WATCH MOVEMENT
items.value: Quartz movement with three-hand analog display; imported women’s wristwatch

items.label: WATER RESISTANT WATCHES FOR WOMEN
items.value: Up to 50m (165ft): Wearable while swimming in shallow water; 5 ATM

items.label: Model
items.value: Pyper Stainless Steel Quartz Watch with Leather Strap
